chars.H: THE HUSBAND: a young Moroccan man about 30 wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.W: THE WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing a burgundy long cardigan over a black top, a beige headscarf and gold hoop earrings.
chars.M: MAROUA (the wife's best friend): a young woman wearing a bright teal puffer vest over a white turtleneck and a light pink headscarf.
chars.X: THE EX-HUSBAND: a man wearing a black leather jacket, a grey t-shirt and dark sunglasses.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND sits hunched on a Moroccan sedari sofa in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, small window, evening lamp light), sneakily holding his wife's phone with a pink case close to his face, with a guilty sly grin, glancing sideways at the closed door as if someone might catch him. Secretive cheeky mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, a Moroccan sedari sofa, a small window, evening lamp light), lying on the sedari scrolling the pink-cased phone, shrugging with a relieved bored face, one eyebrow raised.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, a Moroccan sedari sofa, a small window, evening lamp light) suddenly sits bolt upright, eyes wide in shock, staring at the pink-cased phone held in both hands, dramatic lamp light on him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, a Moroccan sedari sofa, a small window, evening lamp light) quietly closes the bedroom door with one hand while holding the pink-cased phone in the other, looking over his shoulder to make sure no one sees him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Flashback in a cozy Moroccan living room with a big sedari and a teapot on a round table: MAROUA and THE WIFE sit very close together on the sofa, whispering and giggling conspiratorially, both looking at one phone, MAROUA covering her mouth while laughing.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, a Moroccan sedari sofa, a small window, evening lamp light) hesitates, his thumb hovering over the pink-cased phone, sweating and biting his lip, torn between curiosity and guilt.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close view of THE HUSBAND in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, a Moroccan sedari sofa, a small window, evening lamp light), his face lit by the glowing pink-cased phone screen, leaning in with nervous curiosity, holding his breath.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: THE HUSBAND in his old childhood bedroom at his parents' house in Safi, Morocco (green zellige tiles, a Moroccan sedari sofa, a small window, evening lamp light) stands up holding his head with one hand and the pink-cased phone in the other, mouth open in disbelief, completely stunned.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Imagined memory scene on a Moroccan seaside corniche at sunset (Safi cliffs and sea): THE WIFE walks beside THE EX-HUSBAND, she looks at him with a dreamy lovestruck smile while he looks cool and smug. Romantic but suspicious mood.
